doc.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Overbrook: committing himself for alcohol
summary: He admitted himself to Overbrook for six months, realizing he drank because he was praised yet felt he knew nothing.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Well, I know you had your share of health problems in your earlier years, and I think one of –
Yeah. Yeah. Uh-huh (affirmative). I drank. I went to Overbrook because I drank too much alcohol. And I stayed at that thing maybe six months. Something like that.
Overbrook is a mental institution, but they also have a ward in there for alcohol, for drugs, things of that nature.
And so that – I admitted myself. You know. I just got sick of it. I said, "If I keep this up, drinking, I'll kill myself with drinking." So I just – I went on up there. I stayed six months.
Did you play at all while you were there?

Yeah. Because in the first place I blamed everything else for my drinking other than what the fault really was. And then finally I realized that like I'm the one that was doing the drinking, but the reason I drank was because I was being praised. You know. Said, "Boy. Oh, man. You sure sound great." Stuff like that. And I didn't know anything. You see, when you don't know something and people keep telling you, "Boy, you're great. You're great." You say, "I'm great." But I'm not doing anything. And I don't know how to – Whatever I'm doing, I don't know how to make it even better. You know? And so, I mean that had to do with the drinking. You know. Cause I'm doing – You know, I'm playing everything. I hear Sonny Valor is playing (Indiscernible), and I'm playing. That's man, what a good – And they were lerted (phonetic sp.). They knew. So now I'm beginning to know now. And I'd say, "Oh, okay." So I feel very good about it, because I haven't reached my full potential now.
It sounds like that was a real turning point in your life, the time that you spent there.
